integrity: Analytical proof provided with finite independent labelled-state and exact-rational interface-chain checks; no unperformed test is claimed as performed.
limitations: Exact theorem concerns finite spider trees, a single initially dissenting central voter, independent rate-one clocks per vertex and uniformly chosen neighbors. Other initial states, full time distributions, and arbitrary attached motifs are not analyzed; historical priority is qualified.
title: Hub persistence and sharp arm-balance extremals for voter dynamics on spider trees
